content:
[L] high | top-left edge | "Search" heading is clipped at the window edge, rendering as "Search" cut off on the left.
[L] high | top-left edge | subtitle "conversations, knowledge, and customers in one query" is truncated — the leading words ("Find across" or similar) are cut off at the window boundary.
[L] high | bottom-left edge | "Try:" label is clipped at the left window edge, reading as "Try:" partially cut.
[S] high | top-left header block | heading, subtitle, search input, and Clear link are all flush against the window edge with no left inset, breaking any shared grid.
[H] med | header vs subtitle | the subtitle text is nearly as large and equally weighted as the heading, so heading/label roles are indistinguishable.
[S] med | search controls row | vertical alignment is inconsistent — the Search button, input, and Clear link baselines sit at slightly different heights with uneven gaps (input→button tight, button→Clear wide).
[S] med | scope filter row | uneven spacing between scope chips ("All"/"Tickets"/"Knowledge"/"Customers") uses inconsistent gaps rather than a uniform rhythm.
[H] med | scope row | "Scope:" label is small, gray, and floating with weak pairing to the chips it governs.
[S] low | empty state | suggestion links "refund / password reset / billing" sit at the far bottom-left of the search panel instead of grouped with the centered empty-state content.
[C] high | full window | ~55% of the window below the search panel is solid black dead space — the layout collapses entirely with no content, background, or panel treatment filling it.
[C] med | header area | cramped ~130px header strip compressed at the top while the rest of the window is empty, an inverted, unbalanced composition.
[C] med | empty-state | a lone search icon, two lines of text, and three stray links float in a vast gray band with no card or visual anchor, reading as scaffolding rather than a product.
[C] low | Clear button | a "Clear" action is exposed before any query exists, adding pointless control noise to the empty state.
VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped text at the window edges, edge-flushed controls, and a screen that is more than half black dead space read as a debug prototype, not shippable software.
